business_problem: Customer center MONETA Money Bank built by NTT Czech Republic uses an AI-driven voicebot, powered by Feedyou Platform and Microsoft Azure AI, to converse fluently in the complex Czech language, and can gather customer concerns and perform simple tasks like adjust card limits.
solution_summary: MONETA Money Bank used Azure AI Services, Azure AI Speech, Power BI to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. It also connects with surrounding systems such as Call-center telephony, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. As a result, the bank cut call center operational costs by 10 percent, while increasing customer satisfaction.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Speech
solution_components.role: Handles speech recognition and speech synthesis for voice-driven experiences.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

solution_components.name: Azure Machine Learning
solution_components.role: Supports model development, experimentation, and deployment for predictive workloads.
